summary.text: Guy Guzzone is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 13 who has served since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Budget and Taxation Committee and previously served on the Howard County Council and in the House of Delegates.

paragraphs.text: Guzzone was born in Baltimore on March 27, 1964, graduated from Parkville High School, and earned two bachelor's degrees, in economics and in government and politics, from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 1986, followed by a master's degree in public management in 1988.

He was a legislative assistant to U.S. Rep. Bill Nelson of Florida from 1988 to 1991, a special assistant to Howard County Council member Shane Pendergrass from 1991 to 1995, and state director of the Maryland chapter of the Sierra Club from 1996 to 1998.
Guzzone served on the Howard County Council, representing District 3, from 1998 to 2006 and chaired the council in 2001 and from 2003 to 2005.
He was first elected to the House of Delegates in 2006, served from 2007 to 2015 on the Appropriations Committee, and was first elected to the Senate in 2014.
In the Senate he was Majority Whip from 2016 to 2019 and Majority Leader in 2019, and he has chaired the Budget and Taxation Committee since 2020.
He also serves on the Rules, Executive Nominations, Legislative Policy and Spending Affordability committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
